title: Vietnamese Odyssey | Group Tour Package
highlights: Experience Da Nang's allure with its breathtaking beaches, iconic Marble Mountains, and bustling markets—a perfect fusion of nature, culture, and modernity!
Ascend "The Hands of The Gods" at Ba Na Hills for breathtaking views and marvel at giant stone hands holding a golden walkway, a true architectural wonder.
Explore Cu Chi Tunnels to witness Vietnam's resilience and ingenuity during the war, revealing the nation's unwavering spirit.
Travel to Hoi An for charming lantern-lit streets, ancient architecture, and delectable cuisine—experience Vietnam's cultural gem.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi
days.desc: Welcome to Hanoi, known as the City of Soaring Dragon! Upon landing at Noi Bai International Airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel for check-in and relaxation. Once you're settled, you can get ready to explore the vibrant atmosphere of Hanoi at your own pace. Take a leisurely walk around Hoan Kiem Lake, soak in the sights of Thap Ruo Tower, and wander the streets to try local delicacies and shop for souvenirs. Finally, wrap up your day with an overnight stay at your hotel.

days.title: City Tour of Hanoi
days.desc: Today, you'll be transferred to explore the gems of Hanoi with a visit to the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, followed by Quan Thanh Temple and Tran Quoc Pagoda. Then, explore the Bat Trang pottery village, discover the Ethnology Museum and pay respects to the Temple of Literature. Later, soak in the vibrant atmosphere of Old Quarter's 36 streets. You can end your day with a traditional Water Puppet Show [at an extra cost] before transferring back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Stay at Cruise
days.desc: In the morning, check-out and get transferred on a scenic journey from Hanoi to Halong Bay to enjoy an overnight stay aboard a luxurious cruise. Upon arrival at the pier, check-into your cruise and experience the beauty of the limestone caves and emerald waters as you cruise along the Hanoi Bay waters. Relax on deck, enjoy delicious meals, and take part in exciting activities like kayaking and cave exploration. Later in the night, settle in your cabin amidst the surrounding landscapes.

days.title: Transfer from Hanoi to Da Nang
days.desc: Post check-out, disembark the cruise and get transferred to Hanoi airport for your flight to Da Nang. Once you land in the City of Bridges, you'll be transferred to your hotel to check in and relax. Later, you can plan the day at your own pace or enjoy water sports at My Khe Beach, visit Red Beach for some swimming and snorkelling, or wander through the lanes of Con Market. As the day ends, make your way back to your hotel for an overnight night.

days.title: Day Trip to Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge
days.desc: Today, get transferred to admire the beauty of Ba Na Hills. Begin with a scenic cable car ride from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station, soaking in the stunning views along the way. Upon reaching the summit, visit the iconic Golden Bridge. Then, explore the Le Jardin D'Amour, find peace at Linh Ung Pagoda and discover the Debay Wine Cellar followed by a Vietnamese buffet lunch. Afterwards, you can enjoy at Fantasy Park [at an extra cost]. Finally, transfer to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hoi An City Tour | Transfer from Da Nang to Ho Chi Minh City
days.desc: Post check-out, you'll be transferred to explore the ancient town of Hoi An! Visit the Japanese Covered Bridge Pagoda, the Sa Huynh Museum, the Phuoc Kien Assembly Hall, the Silkworm Workshop and the bustling Central Market. Post the tour, transfer back to Da Nang hotel to collect your bags and head to the airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Once you arrive, get transferred to your hotel and check-in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Half-Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour with Cu Chi Tunnel
days.desc: Today, get transferred to explore the vibrant streets of Ho Chi Minh City. Start at the Independence Palace, a symbol of Vietnam's rich history. Then, visit the Notre Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office, showcasing French architecture. Then, discover the War Remnants Museum, a reminder of Vietnam's resilience. Later, conclude your day with the Cu Chi Tunnels, where you'll uncover insights into the country's wartime secrets. Afterwards, transfer to your hotel for an overnight stay.
